chat_message_sources_pages.name: chat_message_sources_pages

chat_messages_validation_status.name: chat_messages_validation_status

chat_messages_no_evidence_exact.name: chat_messages_no_evidence_exact

sop_chunks_pages.name: sop_chunks_pages
sop_chunks_pages.value: ("app"."sop_chunks"."page_start" is null or "app"."sop_chunks"."page_start" >= 1) and ("app"."sop_chunks"."page_end" is null or ("app"."sop_chunks"."page_start" is not null and "app"."sop_chunks"."page_end" >= "app"."sop_chunks"."page_start"))

sop_documents_activation_binding.name: sop_documents_activation_binding
sop_documents_activation_binding.value: ("app"."sop_documents"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "app"."sop_documents"."active_job_id" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."active_pipeline_version" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."active_attempt_id" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."processed_job_id" = "app"."sop_documents"."active_job_id" and "app"."sop_documents"."processed_pipeline_version" = "app"."sop_documents"."active_pipeline_version" and "app"."sop_documents"."processed_attempt_id" = "app"."sop_documents"."active_attempt_id" and "app"."sop_documents"."verified_by" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."verified_at" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."rejection_reason" is null) or ("app"."sop_documents"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' and "app"."sop_documents"."active_job_id" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."active_pipeline_version" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."active_attempt_id" is null)

sop_documents_rejection_binding.name: sop_documents_rejection_binding
sop_documents_rejection_binding.value: ("app"."sop_documents"."status" = 'REJECTED' and "app"."sop_documents"."verified_by" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."verified_at" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."rejection_reason" is not null and length(btrim("app"."sop_documents"."rejection_reason")) > 0) or ("app"."sop_documents"."status" <> 'REJECTED' and "app"."sop_documents"."rejection_reason" is null)

sop_documents_deletion_binding.name: sop_documents_deletion_binding
sop_documents_deletion_binding.value: ("app"."sop_documents"."status" = 'DELETED' and "app"."sop_documents"."deleted_by" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."deleted_at" is not null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_state" in ('PENDING','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED') and "app"."sop_documents"."active_job_id" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."active_pipeline_version" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."active_attempt_id" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."rejection_reason" is null) or ("app"."sop_documents"."status" <> 'DELETED' and "app"."sop_documents"."deleted_by" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."deleted_at" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_state" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_error_code" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_next_at" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_lease_token" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_lease_until" is null and "app"."sop_documents"."cleanup_completed_at" is null)
